column1: # Per-job numbers of the first-build experiment (`tmp-first-build.yml`, two runs on the work branch); see time-budgets.md, "The first compiler build's extra time".
# One row per job: each built the same compiler source twice into an empty target directory, after one preparation (none, reading the Rust toolchain into the page cache, or a 60 s wait).

# Columns: workflow run id, job id, preparation, job number within its arm, CPU model as /proc/cpuinfo prints it, then for the first and the second build: wall seconds (the stage time `run-check.pl` printed), user seconds, system seconds, file-system inputs (blocks, GNU `time`), the build's /proc/pressure/io "full" stall in seconds; last, the seconds the toolchain read took (toolchain arm only).
